result.summary: 本文提出了 Transformer，一种完全基于注意力机制、摒弃循环和卷积的序列转导模型架构 [S1.p4]。作者在 WMT 2014 英德和英法机器翻译任务上验证该模型，英德任务上 big 模型取得 28.4 BLEU，超过此前最佳结果（含集成模型）2 BLEU 以上 [S6.SS1.p1]；英法任务上 big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，超过此前所有单模型 [S6.SS1.p2]。作者还将 Transformer 应用于英语成分句法分析，在仅用 WSJ 40K 句训练时也超过了 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿序列位置逐步计算，其固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。作者希望提出一种不依赖循环、完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入输出全局依赖的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths, as memory constraints limit batching across examples.
In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.

method.text: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器整体结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力与逐位置全连接前馈网络，并配有残差连接和层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。注意力采用缩放点积注意力，即对 query 与所有 key 的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后做 softmax 加权求和 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]；多头注意力将 query、key、value 线性投影 h 次后并行执行注意力 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]。由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦位置编码以注入位置信息 [S3.SS5.p1]。

evidence.quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers. Each layer has two sub-layers.
The decoder is also composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections

Since our model contains no recurrence and no convolution, in order for the model to make use of the order of the sequence, we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence.

experiments.text: 训练数据为 WMT 2014 英德数据集（约 450 万句对）和 WMT 2014 英法数据集（3600 万句） [S5.SS1.p1]。模型在 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU 上训练，base 模型训练 100,000 步约 12 小时，big 模型训练 300,000 步约 3.5 天 [S5.SS2.p1]。作者还在英语成分句法分析任务上验证泛化能力，使用 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分约 40K 训练句，并在半监督设置下使用约 17M 句的语料 [S6.SS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
For English-French, we used the significantly larger WMT 2014 English-French dataset consisting of 36M sentences
We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
We trained the base models for a total of 100,000 steps or 12 hours.
The big models were trained for 300,000 steps (3.5 days).
We trained a 4-layer transformer with $d_{model}=1024$ on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of the Penn Treebank, about 40K training sentences.
We also trained it in a semi-supervised setting, using the larger high-confidence and BerkleyParser corpora from with approximately 17M sentences.

findings.text: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型比此前最佳模型（含集成）高出 2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 BLEU 的新最优结果 [S6.SS1.p1]；在英法任务上 big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，超过此前所有已发表单模型 [S6.SS1.p2]。模型变体实验显示，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多也会导致质量下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；减小注意力 key 维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码结果几乎相同 [S6.SS2.p3]。在英语成分句法分析上，Transformer 在仅用 WSJ 40K 句训练时也超过了 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

evidence.quote: outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more than $2.0$ BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$.
our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models
While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality.
In row (E) we replace our sinusoidal positional encoding with learned positional embeddings, and observe nearly identical results to the base model.
the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences.

limitations.text: 作者指出，自注意力将任意两位置间的操作数降为常数，但代价是注意力加权位置平均导致有效分辨率降低，他们用多头注意力来抵消这一影响 [S2.p1]。对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制在输入序列中以相应输出位置为中心的、大小为 r 的邻域内，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究这一方法 [S4.p4]。作者还表示计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大输入输出 [S7.p3]。

evidence.quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention
self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position.
We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.

We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
